parts.title: Part 1
parts.prompt:
You see the following job advertisement online. Write an email applying for one of the jobs. In your email:
- say which job you're interested in
- give details of any experience you have
- say why you think you'd be good at the job.

Come and work at Hi Bean Café and Food Store
We need waiters, shop assistants and kitchen staff. We're looking for full-time and part-time staff to join our team. Choose when you work!
Generous pay and a great working environment.
Apply to Jake.Brown@hibean.click by 29th January.

parts.title: Part 2
parts.prompt: Write an article for a travel magazine about a beautiful natural location that you like to visit. Describe what you can see and do there, as well as the atmosphere at the location.
